criteria.expectation: Report identifies that the Transaction.updates listener (startListening) is only started from PaywallView's .task, so it is not running until/unless the paywall is shown, and refunds/revocations/Ask-to-Buy approvals arriving otherwise are not observed until the next launch refresh.

Report cites file/line evidence: PaywallView.swift .task calling startListening(), plus EntitlementManager.startListening/init (no init starting it) and/or LumenApp.swift only calling refresh() once at launch.

Report links the cause to both reported symptoms (refund staying unlocked until relaunch; Ask-to-Buy approval not unlocking until relaunch) and notes purchases from the paywall work because purchase() calls refresh() directly and the paywall had started the listener.

Report does not present as the primary cause an unfounded alternative (e.g. missing verification, missing revocationDate check); refresh() already checks verification and revocationDate, and any mention of those is as ruled out or secondary.
Report recommends starting the listener at app launch (e.g. in EntitlementManager.init or LumenApp startup) rather than from a view.

Report states it is a source review and that runtime behavior (actual refund/Ask-to-Buy delivery, device logs, sandbox/TestFlight reproduction) was not run or verified, and does not overclaim certainty beyond the files.
Report does not claim to have modified, built, or run anything, and the input files are unchanged.

Report does not claim as a confirmed defect that the Transaction.updates listener is late/missing, nor that unverified or revoked transactions grant Pro; it may note the listener starts in EntitlementManager.init.
Report states what cannot be verified from source alone (e.g. real refund/Ask-to-Buy delivery, runtime behavior, device/sandbox testing was not performed).

Any extra suggestions (e.g. expiration handling, error surfacing, finishing order, cancelling the task) are explicitly labeled optional/low priority and no major rewrite or blocking change is demanded.
Report gives file/line evidence supporting that the listener starts at launch (init) and that refresh() checks verification and revocationDate.
Report does not claim to have modified, built, or run anything, and the input files are unchanged.
